from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np,json,hashlib
p=Path('/Users/itayzrihan/Desktop/Avihay'); out=Path('analysis/advanced-podcast-2026-10-25'); records=[]; envelopes={}
for f in sorted(p.glob('*.wav')):
 data=np.memmap(f,dtype='<f4',mode='r',offset=44); n=len(data); blocks=n//480
 # Bounded 10-second chunks; no full recording PCM allocation.
 env=np.empty(blocks,dtype=np.float32)
 for start in range(0,blocks,1000):
  end=min(start+1000,blocks); a=np.asarray(data[start*480:end*480]).reshape(-1,480)
  env[start:end]=np.sqrt(np.mean(a.astype(np.float64)**2,axis=1))
 key=f.stem.rsplit('_',1)[1]; envelopes.setdefault(key,[]).append(env)
 records.append({'name':f.name,'bytes':f.stat().st_size,'samples':n,'sampleRate':48000,'channels':1,'format':'IEEE float32','durationSeconds':n/48000,'recorderToken':key,'sequence':int(f.stem.split('_')[2]),'metadataChunks':['fmt ','data'],'headerSha256':hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()[:44]).hexdigest()})
(out/'recordings.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
for key,es in envelopes.items():np.save(out/(key+'-rms-10ms.npy'),np.concatenate(es))
print(json.dumps(records,indent=2))
